introduction: Virginia offers alternative income-based tax credits. Eligible filers should compare them and claim only the option allowed by the instructions.
description: Virginia offers alternative income-based tax credits. Eligible filers should compare them and claim only the option allowed by the instructions.

sections.who: Federal EITC eligibility is needed for the state EITC route. Certain claimed exemptions, deductions or dependency circumstances can disqualify it.
sections.get: The refundable EITC is 20% of federal EITC for 2025 and 2026. Nonrefundable EITC and the low-income credit are separate alternatives, not amounts to add together.
sections.docs:
• Federal return and EITC calculation.
  • The matching Virginia return and Schedule ADJ.
  • Income, dependency and claimed subtraction information.
sections.apply:
1. Use the correct year

    Check Virginia’s return instructions for the year being filed.

  2. Compare options

    Review Virginia income-based credits and exclusions.

  3. Claim one eligible option

    Complete Schedule ADJ and attach it to the state return as instructed.
sections.after: Keep the calculation and both returns. Respond to any Taxation verification notice.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Virginia income-based credit rules; 2025–26 change. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Can I add all three credits?
No. Virginia says to claim only one.
Can refundable EITC exceed tax owed?
Taxation directs applicants to Schedule ADJ.
